reviews.review: This game really shouldn't have said "from the makers of l4d" because it set the bar too high. Its pretty fun but the design choices will turn most l4d fans away as it doesn't share the same core gameplay and tone. Another thing is that only 3 people on the dev team were from the original turtle rock that "worked" on l4d when they only came up with the idea of it and then valve picked up where they left off. It tried to be both its own game and a l4d successor which just doesn't work with how the game functions and its a shame they didn't keep working on it to make it have its own identity. The card system is great and bad at the same time because you get to customize your experience but after a certain point it makes the game pretty easy. Last nail in the coffin was no mod support because it would've fixed alot of what people didn't like and would've increased its lifespan longer than the year and a half that it was supported. Def worth it on sale and if you play with friends.
If you like team based games and beating the crap out of the undead than I recommend this game to anyone out there!
